model_note: v1's DC SCUC (binary commitment, transition, startup, quadratic fuel cost, per-state recourse) on the observed hourly load shape. Cost probe only.

declared.purpose: bounded solve-cost diagnostic including the observed hourly load shape; successor to staged_deliverability_grid_scuc_cost_v1
declared.load_rule: case_load_h = case_reference * (observed_h / observed_mean); stage 1's declared mapping, unchanged
declared.infeasible_hours_rule: hours with case_load > 3405.0 cannot be served by any commitment; reported, never dropped
declared.inherited_from_v1: model, solver settings, state selection, startup cost, declared ramp and minimum up/down, budget and stop rules

inherited_model.purpose: bounded solve-cost diagnostic for the stage-2 SCUC gate
inherited_model.load_rule: case reference demand held flat for every hour
inherited_model.cost_charged_on: base state only; contingency states add constraints
inherited_model.state_selection: one branch outaged per state, case order, non-islanding only (union-find over in-service branches)
inherited_model.startup_cost_source: case24 gencost STARTUP = 1500 for every unit; generic RTS value, not per-technology, not calibrated
excluded: spinning reserve envelope and RTS-GMLC DC branches
inherited_model.direction_of_bias: the probe is expected to be cheaper per solve than the production formulation because it omits reserve envelopes and the RTS-GMLC unit set; if the probe already exceeds the budget, the production model does too. The reverse inference is not made.

load_window.infeasible_reason: case load above the fleet ceiling 3405.0 MW

structural_screen.rule: an hour is servable iff case_load <= 3405.0 MW (fleet total pmax); a window is feasible iff every hour is
structural_screen.run_before: any solve; no cost was read when this ran
structural_screen.window_choice_rule: earliest servable window; fixed, not selected against any cost or objective
